name: Booster Blast
author: Yu-Gi-Oh-Ex
description: 89 booster packs and 16 Structure Decks of the cards released after the game, as the real sets.
details: Turn on with the Cards mod. Each booster pack is a whole set the Cards mod's cards debuted in (by TCG date), reprints of cards the game already has included, in a shop row per year; OCG-only cards, promos and older cards the game never had get a pack each in the Extras row (Card Store > Buy Booster Packs). Structure Decks are bought on Card Store > Buy Decks (pages\booster-blast-decks.bob), whole and once per save, into your saved decks with 3 of every card. Yu-Gi-Oh-Core shares the game's free pack slots between rows, so there is no limit on packs.
